textbookBox.concept: The poem asks a simple question: where does the bright Sun go at night? In the poem, the Sun seems to slip behind a distant hill. The place where the child lives grows dark and quiet.

beats.en: Day and night happen because the Earth turns. The side facing the Sun has daylight. The Sun keeps shining while our side turns away.
beats.speakEn: Day and night happen because the Earth turns. The side facing the Sun has daylight. The Sun keeps shining while our side turns away.

Rule: Day and night happen because the Earth turns. The side facing the Sun has daylight.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Night (poem) · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: At sunrise and sunset the sky shows orange, red, pink and yellow. In the night sky we can see the Moon and many stars. During the day we see the Sun, clouds and birds.

beats.en: At sunrise and sunset the sky shows orange, red, pink and yellow. In the night sky we can see the Moon and many stars. During the day we see the Sun, clouds and birds.

beats.en: To wonder is to think about something and want to know about it. Distant means far away. Peep means to look or appear for a short time.
beats.speakEn: To wonder is to think about something and want to know about it. Distant means far away. Peep means to look or appear for a short time.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Night (poem) · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Some words start with two consonant sounds that come one after another. We say them together in a blend, and both sounds are still there. Sp words are spy, spin, spoon and splash.
